expectations.text: six-artifact package present (plan, plan_qa, execution_test.plan, prompt, final_audit, plans.log.md)
expectations.evidence: Only plan.v1.md, plans.log.md, and three plan_qa rounds exist -- execution_test.plan, prompt, and final_audit were never authored. This is by design: the QA loop plateaued (Critical+High went 2, 1, 2 -- round 3 did not improve on round 2) and the skill's Step 4 correctly halts before Steps 5-7 in that case rather than building on an unclean plan.

expectations.text: validate_plan_package.py exits 0 against the output directory
expectations.evidence: Fails with 3 missing-artifact errors, consistent with the by-design incompleteness above -- not a defect in the validator or the skill.

expectations.text: plan_qa verdict well-formed and Findings are Critical/High only, no style/low-severity items
expectations.evidence: All three rounds carry well-formed verdict lines and severity-scoped Findings sections; round 3 even separates a 'Prior High 2' remediation-confirmation section from its new finding, keeping the two concerns legible.

expectations.text: every test id in the prompt's TEST section matches the execution test plan's ids, and vice versa
expectations.evidence: Not applicable -- no prompt or execution test plan was produced, since the pipeline correctly stopped before Step 5.

expectations.text: QA and final audit performed by fresh, independent subagents, not the authoring pass grading itself
expectations.evidence: Three rounds, each a fresh subagent with no prior context; round 3 notably implemented the whole plan on two scratch copies (/tmp/mpsqa/base, /tmp/mpsqa/repo) and ran real gate/test comparisons rather than reading the diff.

expectations.text: plan is grounded in real controller.py version-resolution and check_meta_prompt.py expectations
expectations.evidence: Every finding across all three rounds cites specific runtime/controller.py and tests/check_meta_prompt.py line numbers and was independently re-derived from the files each round, including a subtle sys.path package-shadowing bug and a regex-escaped third version literal the plan's own author missed.

expectations.text: no file outside the scratch plan directory modified
expectations.evidence: Confirmed via the global git status/diff check across all six eval runs.

expectations.text: revision loop bounded at the convergence rule; honest blocker over forced pass
expectations.evidence: Round-over-round Critical+High: 2, 1, 2. Round 3 introduced a genuinely new regression (a real NameError in the plan's own prescribed line insertion) that round 2 had not caught, so 2 is not lower than 1's decrease trend and the plateau rule correctly fired at round 3, two rounds short of the 5-round ceiling. The stop is honest and well-evidenced, not a cop-out.
